The PR segments assistant text around tool cards, assigns distinct replay turn identities, persists TUI-local `!`/`!!` commands through a new hidden gateway RPC, replays those entries, condenses tool cards, and adds verbose-off activity summaries.

PR surface: Source +617, Tests +629, Other +46. Total +1292 across 29 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the ordering regression: current main’s per-run assistant component reuse provides a high-confidence source path, and the branch adds focused regression tests. Shell persistence and verbose-off activity summaries are new capabilities rather than reproduced bugs.

target.title: fix(tui): keep chat history in order; persist local shell commands to history
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where, in TUI verbose mode, assistant text generated after a mid-run
tool call would render *above* the tool call's card instead of below it — because
the same streaming text component kept getting overwritten in place rather than a
new one starting after the tool card. The same underlying bug also caused two
replayed history turns with no tool call between them to collapse onto a single
component on session resume, showing only the later turn's reply stranded at the
earlier turn's position.

Also resolves an issue where TUI-local `!`-prefixed shell commands (run on the
operator's own machine, not the gateway) were purely ephemeral: closing the TUI lost
them, and the agent could never see a command the user had just run or its output,
even to reference it in the next turn.

## Why This Change Was Made

`ChatLog` tracked one streaming component per run and kept rewriting it for the
life of the whole agentic loop, with no boundary at a tool call or, in history
replay, between separate historical turns. Added a committed-text/segment
mechanism so a tool card freezes the text before it, and any further text (live
or replayed) starts a fresh component positioned after it.

For the second issue: the data model for persisting a shell-command transcript
message (`BashExecutionMessage`, with an `excludeFromContext` flag) already
existed in the codebase and was already wired into LLM-context assembly and
compaction — nothing in the app ever called it. Wired the TUI's local shell
runner up to it: `!cmd` persists agent-visible (the agent sees it next turn);
`!!cmd` persists history-only (kept out of the agent's context, matching the
data model's existing doc comments). Added the small additive gateway RPC and
protocol schema this needed, an implementation for both TUI backends, and a
history-replay render branch for the message role (previously unhandled there,
so it would have silently vanished on session resume).

Two smaller cleanups rode along in the same session: tool-call cards had
unconditional top/bottom padding rendering 4 lines for 2 lines of content
(trimmed), and verbose-off mode had zero tool feedback at all (added a
one-line "fuzzy" activity summary, e.g. "Read 2 files, ran 1 command and
searched for 3 patterns", updating in place per run).

## User Impact

- Verbose-mode conversations now render in true chronological order, live and
  on session resume — no more assistant replies appearing to answer the wrong
  question or duplicate earlier text.
- `!`/`!!` shell commands run from the TUI now show up in scrollback after
  resuming a session, and `!` output is visible to the agent on its next turn
  (useful for "here's what that command printed, now do X with it" workflows)
  while `!!` stays local-only.
- Tool call cards take less vertical space, and verbose-off sessions get a
  compact one-line activity summary instead of no tool feedback at all.

## Evidence

- Full `src/tui` suite: 28 files / 650 tests, all green (+9 new this round on
  top of the ordering/activity-summary work).
- Fake-backend PTY end-to-end smoke lane: 18/18 green.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` clean.
- New/updated tests per surface: `chat-log.test.ts` (ordering + duplication
  regressions), `tui-session-actions.test.ts` (session-resume ordering +
  bashExecution history replay), `tool-activity-summary.test.ts` (new),
  `tui-event-handlers.test.ts`, `chat.inject-bash-execution.test.ts` (new,
  real transcript fixtures), `gateway-chat.test.ts` + `embedded-backend.test.ts`
  (both TUI backend implementations), `tui-local-shell.test.ts` (`!` vs `!!`
  behavior), `server-methods-list.test.ts` (new RPC is hidden + dispatchable).
- Manually verified `!`/`!!` end-to-end via `pnpm tui --local`.
